title: Biased AI improves human decision-making but reduces trust

bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating the political stance of an AI assistant (e.g., Strong Democrat, Strong Republican, Neutral) via system prompts and evaluating the impact on human fact-checking accuracy, user trust, and engagement during human-AI interactions. The study also measures human 'evaluative bias' by comparing post-interaction performance across Republican-favored, Democrat-favored, and Neutral news headlines.
